3. Defendant Nos.1, 2, 5 and 10-14 contested the suit by filing joint written statement, denying the plaint case. It is their case that suit land owned and possessed by one, Kafiron Bewa who died leaving son Noor Mohammad and 3 daughters, Feli alias Muni Bibi, Afizan Bibi and Mirjan Bibi as heirs. S.A. record of right was duly prepared and published in their names along with the heirs of other C.S. recorded tenants. S.A. recorded tenant Gamir Uddin Mondal and others filed Other Class suit No.68 of 1965 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Rajshahi against Noor Mohammad Mondal and his sisters, Muni Bewa and Mirjan and heirs of Afizan. Ultimately the said suit was decreed on the basis of solenama between the plaintiffs and defendant Nos.1-4, 6-12, 14-16 and 19. During R.S. operation suit land has duly been recorded in the name of Noor Mohammad. Noor Mohammad subsequently died, leaving his first wife, Mafizan, plaintiff, 2nd wife Alekjan Bibi and 3rd wife, Most. Fatema Bewa, defendant No.5 and sons of Noor Mohammad Mondal, defendant Nos.1, 2, 3 and 4 and 9 daughters, defendant Nos.6-9 and 10-14 as heirs and they all entered into ejmali possession of the suit land. Noor Mohammad Mondal never transferred the suit land to plaintiff by patta in exchange of her dower money and she never enjoyed and possessed the suit land by herself alone. Noor Mohammad Mondal and the plaintiff, has manipulated and fabricated the alleged patta in the name of plaintiff only to deprive his step brothers, sisters and step mothers, filed the instant false stilt, is liable to be dismissed. 

 4. Mr. Noor Nabi, learned Advocate, appeared for the defendant-petitioners, submits that court of appeal below without considering material on record and without considering that plaintiff's are not in possession of the suit land and suit land did not possess by her husband but through her husband who possessing the suit land after his death, the suit land was in ejmali possession of the heirs of Noor Mohammad Mondal as such, the impugned judgment and decree is liable to set aside. Learned Advocate further submits that in allowing appeal and decreeing the suit court of appeal below did not reverse the findings of trial court as regard fairness of patta which the learned Judge of trial court empathetically found. 

 6. Only question calls for determination as to whether patta in favour of plaintiff by her husband is genuine or not. Trial court held that patta is a spurious document as writing of patta has been smeared by soaking and plaintiff failed to prove possession pursuant to the patta. Appellate court in the body of the judgment found that plaintiff possessing the suit land and D.W.1 in his cross-examination admitted that suit property is her own property. P.Ws in their depositions proved patta exhibit-4, P.W.2 proved hand writings of Noor Mohammad Mondal. It is in the evidence that exhibit-4 was exhibited without any objection. Defendant's case is that suit land was not in possession of plaintiff by herself. In our country, it is the go of the day women are shaky in proving that she is in possession of the suit land. Moreover, it is in record that plaintiff is a pordanshin lady. S.A. and R.S. record was prepared in the name of her husband, Noor Mohammad Mondal. Learned Judge of the appellate court considers "Record of right does not create or extinguish the title, it merely raises a presumption of accuracy but the presumption is rebuttable (AIR 1963 Ori. 29; AIR 1968 Pat. 450 at 453). It is no evidence of title, 2 Cal. LJ page 305" Against wrong preparation of record of right, limitation is 6 (six) years for filing suit for declaration, is not applicable when it is proved plaintiffs are in possession for long period.
